notes: Important upgrade-safety fix: Wingman will no longer send a command (like "show install summary") into a device session while another command — such as an install add — is still running. A terminal session is a single channel, and interleaving commands into a live install can corrupt it. Commands on a session are now strictly one-at-a-time.

Install steps now wait for the device's real completion signal (its SUCCESS/FAILED line) instead of a brief prompt that can flash mid-operation, so Wingman knows an install is truly done before it reads status or moves on.
If you ask Wingman something while a device is mid-install, it now tells you the device is still running that step and waits, rather than poking the busy session.
